style.styleTitle: Personalised Feather Memorial Christmas Bauble by No Ordinary Gift
style.toneOfVoice: A delicate glass memorial bauble printed with an elegant white illustration. The bauble can be personalised with a name that sits centrally in the design, along with a line of custom text that curves around the outer edge at the top of the bauble. The text will be printed exactly as entered in the personalisation fields provided, and only the detail is included as standard.<br><br>The design will be printed in white ink onto a clear polyester sheet, which is then inserted into the bauble. The bauble is finished with a grosgrain hanging ribbon in a choice of colours and measures approximately 8 x 8 cm.<br>most personalised items will be delivered within 7 days; estimated delivery will be confirmed at the point of order. Please note that personalised items cannot be cancelled once your order is placed. Please do not include accents, special symbols, or emojis, as some of our processes will not allow this. These items are made especially for you, so they can only be returned if they are faulty, do not fit their description, or do not meet with your instruction.
